title: Carbon-Aware Placement
description: Carbon-Aware Placement is a scheduling ability in the Energy-Efficient Compute Scheduling database. Places jobs in regions where the grid is cleanest right now. Grid carbon intensity feeds the placer; jobs shift to low-carbon regions when possible. It takes carbon feed and produces placements. Tunable parameters: gCO2/kWh. Guarantee: placements never violate data residency.

fields.mechanism: Grid carbon intensity feeds the placer; jobs shift to low-carbon regions when possible.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Time Shifting
description: Time Shifting is a scheduling ability in the Energy-Efficient Compute Scheduling database. Delays flexible jobs to low-carbon hours. Jobs tagged flexible wait for the daily carbon trough; deadlines still bind. It takes job flexibility and produces shifted schedule. Tunable parameters: trough hours. Guarantee: deadlines are never missed for shifting.

fields.mechanism: Jobs tagged flexible wait for the daily carbon trough; deadlines still bind.
fields.guarantees: deadlines are never missed for shifting

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Power Capping
description: Power Capping is a scheduling ability in the Energy-Efficient Compute Scheduling database. Caps node power draw during peak grid stress. Caps lower CPU frequency; the scheduler packs jobs to fewer capped nodes. It takes grid signals and produces capped nodes. Tunable parameters: per node watts. Guarantee: caps never break running jobs.

fields.mechanism: Caps lower CPU frequency; the scheduler packs jobs to fewer capped nodes.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Idle Harvesting
description: Idle Harvesting is a scheduling ability in the Energy-Efficient Compute Scheduling database. Fills idle capacity with batch work instead of leaving machines on. Idle nodes pull from the batch queue; they drain before any shutdown. It takes idle nodes and produces filled capacity. Tunable parameters: batch only. Guarantee: interactive jobs always preempt batch.

fields.mechanism: Idle nodes pull from the batch queue; they drain before any shutdown.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Cooling-Aware Packing
description: Cooling-Aware Packing is a scheduling ability in the Energy-Efficient Compute Scheduling database. Packs jobs to minimize cooling energy, not just CPU. Hot jobs spread across cooling zones; the packer models thermal output per job. It takes thermal model and produces packing. Tunable parameters: per zone. Guarantee: no zone ever exceeds its thermal budget.

fields.mechanism: Hot jobs spread across cooling zones; the packer models thermal output per job.
fields.guarantees: no zone ever exceeds its thermal budget

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Energy Accounting
description: Energy Accounting is a scheduling ability in the Energy-Efficient Compute Scheduling database. Meters energy per job with real sensor data. Node power sensors attribute watts to jobs by CPU share; each job gets a kWh receipt. It takes sensors and produces job receipts. Tunable parameters: per job. Guarantee: estimates are always labeled as estimates.

fields.mechanism: Node power sensors attribute watts to jobs by CPU share; each job gets a kWh receipt.
fields.guarantees: estimates are always labeled as estimates

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Green SLAs
description: Green SLAs is a scheduling ability in the Energy-Efficient Compute Scheduling database. Offers service tiers with carbon budgets attached. Each tier caps grams of CO2 per job; over-budget jobs are rescheduled, not failed. It takes tier config and produces tier compliance. Tunable parameters: gCO2/job. Guarantee: tiers never silently exceed budget.

fields.mechanism: Each tier caps grams of CO2 per job; over-budget jobs are rescheduled, not failed.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Renewable Matching
description: Renewable Matching is a scheduling ability in the Energy-Efficient Compute Scheduling database. Matches compute demand to renewable supply curves. Solar and wind forecasts shape the schedule; compute follows the supply. It takes renewable forecast and produces matched schedule. Tunable parameters: hourly. Guarantee: matching never strands urgent jobs.

fields.mechanism: Solar and wind forecasts shape the schedule; compute follows the supply.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: E-Waste Tracking
description: E-Waste Tracking is a scheduling ability in the Energy-Efficient Compute Scheduling database. Tracks hardware lifecycles to schedule replacements efficiently. Server age and failure rates feed a replacement plan that minimizes waste. It takes inventory and produces replacement plan. Tunable parameters: per server. Guarantee: retired hardware is always recycled.

fields.mechanism: Server age and failure rates feed a replacement plan that minimizes waste.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Sleep Scheduling
description: Sleep Scheduling is a scheduling ability in the Energy-Efficient Compute Scheduling database. Puts idle nodes to sleep instead of idling hot. Nodes with no leases for 10 minutes sleep; wake-on-LAN brings them back in 30 s. It takes idle timers and produces sleeping nodes. Tunable parameters: 10 min. Guarantee: sleep never strands a queued job.

fields.mechanism: Nodes with no leases for 10 minutes sleep; wake-on-LAN brings them back in 30 s.
fields.guarantees: sleep never strands a queued job

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Energy Dashboards
description: Energy Dashboards is a scheduling ability in the Energy-Efficient Compute Scheduling database. Shows energy and carbon per team in plain numbers. Metered data aggregates by team with trends and comparisons. It takes meter data and produces dashboards. Tunable parameters: per team. Guarantee: numbers always come from meters, not models.

fields.mechanism: Metered data aggregates by team with trends and comparisons.

title: Workload Shaping
description: Workload Shaping is a scheduling ability in the Energy-Efficient Compute Scheduling database. Smooths spiky workloads to avoid power peaks. Bursts are spread over minutes where latency allows; peaks drop without hurting SLAs. It takes spike profile and produces smoothed load. Tunable parameters: latency budget. Guarantee: SLAs are never breached for smoothing.

fields.mechanism: Bursts are spread over minutes where latency allows; peaks drop without hurting SLAs.
fields.guarantees: SLAs are never breached for smoothing

title: Battery Buffering
description: Battery Buffering is a scheduling ability in the Energy-Efficient Compute Scheduling database. Uses on-site batteries to ride through dirty-grid hours. Batteries charge on clean power and discharge during peaks; the scheduler times it. It takes battery state and produces charge plan. Tunable parameters: per site. Guarantee: batteries never drain below reserve.

fields.mechanism: Batteries charge on clean power and discharge during peaks; the scheduler times it.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Efficiency Benchmarks
description: Efficiency Benchmarks is a scheduling ability in the Energy-Efficient Compute Scheduling database. Benchmarks jobs by energy per unit of work. Each job type gets a joules-per-task baseline; regressions flag for review. It takes job metrics and produces baselines. Tunable parameters: per type. Guarantee: baselines are always re-measured, not assumed.

fields.mechanism: Each job type gets a joules-per-task baseline; regressions flag for review.

title: Carbon Reports
description: Carbon Reports is a scheduling ability in the Energy-Efficient Compute Scheduling database. Publishes auditable carbon reports per period. Metered energy times grid intensity yields the report; methodology is attached. It takes meter data and produces report. Tunable parameters: monthly. Guarantee: reports never use grid averages silently.

fields.mechanism: Metered energy times grid intensity yields the report; methodology is attached.
fields.guarantees: reports never use grid averages silently
